$comment: Identity-based debt ratchet for scripts/migration/check-registry.mjs (GA recovery step 2C). Every entry in `problems` is the exact message the gate emitted for a pre-existing problem when this baseline was frozen; the gate treats a listed string as known debt (visible, counted, non-fatal) and treats anything else — including a listed string that stops reproducing — as new debt, which fails the run. This file exists to be emptied: paying a problem down means deleting its line here in the same commit that fixes it, never leaving a stale line behind. It must be empty by emptyByWave; the gate prints that deadline alongside the known-debt count on every run so it cannot be forgotten.
